_what: Every check, with numbers. A check is credited only where its seeded defect moved the agreement count.

three_independent_establishments: Results text names lipids 14 and 32-42 as the library
Supp Fig 2 legend prints a pKa for each of exactly those 12
Fig 2 legend has 12 swatches; Fig 3C/D/E have 13 category ticks = Untreated + 12
L1_library_size.note: 12 DISTINCT IONIZABLE STRUCTURES = 12 LNP formulations. One composition (40:48.5:10:1.5, N/P 9) for all of them, so 'N lipids' and 'N formulations' coincide here. The count that multiplies is the VALUES: 3 cell lines x 3 doses in vitro.

S1_isomeric_pairs_exist.why: Mass and formula are BLIND to these. Lipid 34/36 differ only in which side of the linker carries the carbonyl, and the SI prints [M+1]+ 907.2 and 907.3 for them. The direction is carried only by the IUPAC name and the synthesis route.

S2_linker_direction.note: The seed changes NOTHING a mass or formula check can see: both are C56H111N3O5, exact mass 905.852 either way.

S3_mass_three_ways.leg_1_ours_vs_their_formula: THE SI PRINTS NO MOLECULAR FORMULA for any lipid -- only an IUPAC name and an m/z. This leg does not exist for this paper and is reported as absent rather than manufactured by re-deriving the formula from the same name the structure was built from, which would compare a value to itself.
S3_mass_three_ways.note: All 11 printed m/z sit 0.23-0.38 Da BELOW our average-mass [M+H]+ -- a systematic offset, not a structural disagreement. What a systematic offset cannot survive is the DIFFERENCES between lipids, and those reproduce to <=0.33 Da.

S4_nmr_integral_sum.note: Independent of the mass spectrum and sensitive to composition (not to connectivity). Five are exact; three are short by exactly the amide/urea NH the SI does not report; lipid 35 is +2 and lipid 42 is -5, both from overlapping multiplets in the printed list. Recorded, not reconciled.

S5_linker_from_1H_NMR.no_13C_in_this_SI: searched all 42 SI pages: '13C' 0 hits, 'C NMR' 0, '100 MHz' 0, '125 MHz' 0, 'HRMS' 0. Only 1H at 400 MHz and ESI-TOF m/z to one decimal. The d155-vs-d173 carbonate/ester test is unavailable here and is NOT claimed.
S5_linker_from_1H_NMR.carbamate_is_impossible: A carbamate would need an N-H or N-alkyl nitrogen on one side of the C=O. For lipids 33 and 39 the CDI acylation is between alcohol 2 and a head ALCOHOL (3-dimethylamino-1-propanol; 2-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)ethanol), and every nitrogen in both partners is TERTIARY -- the core N carries two C8 arms plus the hydroxyethyl, the head N carries two methyls or is a piperazine N. There is no N-H anywhere to acylate, so carbamate is excluded by valence, not by preference.
S5_linker_from_1H_NMR.third_line_of_evidence: The IUPAC name says it outright: lipid 33 is '...-7-oxo-6,8-DIOXA-2,11-diazanonadecan-19-yl...', i.e. O6-C7(=O)-O8, a dialkyl carbonate; lipid 39 is '...(ethoxy)CARBONYL)OXY)ethyl...'.
S5_linker_from_1H_NMR.note: Three independent lines, none of them mass: the 1H O-CH2 count (8 H for both carbonates, 6 H for all four esters, 4 H for all six amide-family linkers, 11/11), the valence argument that excludes carbamate, and the printed name.

F2_1_calibration.note: Scale AND origin from the panel's own dashed decade gridlines. The solid axis rule is EXCLUDED even though it sits on a decade in every panel: it is the panel box, and a box that happens to be right teaches nothing (error class 20).

F2_2_printed_pearson_r.seeded_defect: lipid labels rotated by one bar group
F2_2_printed_pearson_r.note: pKa is a TIER-4 EXACT vector (printed as text in the Supp Fig 2 legend), so this compares our digitised luminescence against a number the authors computed and printed, through a quantity we did not digitise. It also identifies WHICH dose the correlation panels used: the middle one.

F3_1_calibration.note: The y scale comes from the MAJOR ticks only, separated from the eight minor ticks per decade by run length; the x (category) scale comes from the 13 axis ticks below the baseline, because the bars touch and cannot delimit themselves.

F3_2_lungs_vs_pKa.computed_on: RAW radiance, not log10 -- Supp Fig 5C's y axis reads 'Avg Radiance' on a log scale, where A/B/D/E/F read 'Log10 (Avg Radiance)'. On log10 we get r=0.886, which is 0.044 from the printed value; on raw radiance 0.837, which is 0.005 from it.
F3_2_lungs_vs_pKa.seeded_defect: panel C's bottom axis label re-read as 10^6, i.e. three decades over the same four ticks

F3_3_panel_C_decade_ladder.conclusion: FOUR equally spaced major ticks. A 10^8..10^6 reading would need one of them unlabelled, which GraphPad does not draw; 10^8..10^5 at 47.45 px per decade is the only ladder consistent with the furniture, and check F3_2 then reproduces the printed Pearson r to 0.005.
F3_3_panel_C_decade_ladder.note: The bottom glyph is 8 px of JPEG and reads equally as 5 or 6. This check does not read it; it measures the spacing.

F3_4_minor_ticks_pin_the_decade.note: Eight minor ticks per decade at log10(2..9) -- UNEQUALLY spaced, so they pin the decade length rather than merely being consistent with it. This is what settles panel C's ladder; check F3_2 only moves by 0.034 under the wrong ladder, because a monotone rescaling barely perturbs a Pearson coefficient, and on its own it would NOT have settled anything.

X1_supp_fig5_panel_labels.retired_suspicion: On first reading, the x-axis RANGES of Supp Fig 5D (5-9) and 5E (4-8) looked swapped relative to their titles (RAW264.7 and HeLa). This matrix retires that: each labelled pairing is the largest in its row by >=0.15, so the titles are right and the ranges were misjudged by eye.
X1_supp_fig5_panel_labels.residual: Our values are 0.03-0.08 below the printed r. Check X2 shows that one censored point accounts for it.

X2_censoring_sensitivity.conclusion: Lipid 39 has NO lungs bar; we store the axis floor (9.9e4) as an upper bound. Putting its true value at 1e4-3e4 instead reproduces both printed coefficients (0.870-0.888 vs 0.8843 and 0.845-0.858 vs 0.8428). So the residual in X1 is the censoring, not a read error, and the upper-bound flag on that row is doing real work.

A1_anchor_present.note: BYTE IDENTITY IS NOT THE SIGNAL (F-037). A correct re-derivation canonicalises to the same string as a correct enumeration. What matters is that make_reference.py shares no code path with stage01: it uses no curation/lib/assemble call, no esterify, no attach, no RWMol, and composes the molecule head-first from the IUPAC name's own locants. provenance/check_anchor_independence.py was NOT run -- it writes tracked files other agents are using -- so the posture is argued in PROVENANCE.md and the generator is here to read.
